featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited at your place and had a delightful experience. I tried their **Aloo Paratha** and **Methi Thepla**, and both were fantastic!

The paratha was perfectly cooked, with a crisp golden-brown exterior and a delicious, well-seasoned potato filling. It was served with tangy curd and flavorful pickle, which complemented it beautifully. The portion size was generous, making it satisfying and filling.  And The thepla was soft yet slightly crispy around the edges, with a subtle bitterness from the methi (fenugreek) balanced by mild spices. It was light, healthy, and ideal for a quick bite. Paired with their chutney or curd, it was a treat for the taste buds.
The ambiance of the restaurant was cozy, and the service was prompt and friendly. Definitely a must-visit spot if you’re craving authentic North Indian and Gujarati flavors!

Mitran Da Dhaba is an amazing place if you love authentic Punjabi dhaba-style tandoor food. This is a complete dhaba experience, so I’d strongly recommend ordering their tandoor specials, parathas, and even Chinese dishes rather than Mughlai or biryanis.

The place has an open-space setup, which feels great when you’re dining with friends or family. Everything is very clean and hygienically prepared, and it really feels like there are specialized chefs handling specific dishes — the taste clearly reflects their expertise. Portions are very generous, so you definitely get good value for money.

All tandoori dishes are outstanding and cooked live in front of you, which adds to the experience. Must-try items include Reshmi Kebab, Kheema Paratha, Chicken Fried Rice, White Makhan Tandoori Chicken, and of course the Gulab Jamuns, which are absolutely amazing.

Parking is convenient — you can park your car or bike on the opposite side of the road, and since there’s usually no traffic jam after 8 PM, it’s quite hassle-free. Do note that menu prices are exclusive of GST, so factor that in while ordering.

Weekends can get crowded, but weekday evenings are comfortable and much less busy, making it a perfect time for a relaxed dinner.

Overall, a must-visit dhaba for tandoor lovers! 🔥🍗
